THE SAVOY MALE AND FEMALE COLLEGE 17

T. V. Gorrell.²¹ His active unofficial support continued through the later years of the College and his children were listed among its prominent students.

²¹Interview with Mrs. A. F. (Lide Gorrell) Moore at Savoy, Texas, August 7, 1938. She further states that the surviving children of Mr. Gorrell are: Mrs. Lee Gorrell Gregory, Oklahoma City, Oklahoma; Mrs. A. F. (Lide) Moore, Keene, Texas; Mrs. W. L. (Jessie) Young, Route 3, Bonham, Texas; and Mr. W. F. Gorrell of Crowell, Texas.
